spinner: A cassette tape reel in a pressed well: a beige three-notch hub turns steadily over the dark tape pack, with the BUSY lamp lit and still in the spindle.
skeleton: Long rounded vent slots pressed into the beige plastic, moulded in once, with a soft orange lamp scanning along behind each slot, one after another.
switch: A ribbed plastic slider in a pressed slot, with an indicator lamp at the end that is a dark dot when off and a lit lens when on.
check: The checkbox is a well that takes the deep orange plate with a light tick punched in; the chosen radio is the panel's lamp, a lit LED lens in a dark bezel.
toast: A moulded panel with a lit LED at its leading edge that pops down into place once, its lamp striking as it lands.
dialog: A hatch screwed down at four corners with its title on the Michroma case-label face, popping down into the console once.
tooltip: A strip of embossed label tape: raised light letters in tracked uppercase mono on dark tape, stamped on once.
steps: A row of moulded plastic keys with numbers; done keys carry a deep orange tick and the current key is pressed in with its lamp lit beside it.
empty: An empty bay in the console: a pressed-in panel with a vent grille and the title on a strip of label tape.
link: Ink with a faint orange underline; under the pointer the underline lights in the deep orange at full weight, an indicator coming on.
